subQuestions.subQuestion: Suggest a chemical test to show how to distinguish between ethenyl ethanoate and ethyl ethanoate.
subQuestions.subAnswer:
Bromine test - ethenyl ethanoate can decolourise orange / brown / yellow bromine / Br<sub>2</sub> solution immediately while ethyl ethanoate cannot. (NOT Accept Br). (Require the mention the reaction of Br<sub>2</sub> with ethenyl ethanoate is much faster than ethyl ethanoate). /
Treating with acidified potassium permanganate solution - ethenyl ethanoate can decolourise pruple acifified potassium permanganate solution while ethyl ethanoate cannot. (Also accept treating with potassium permanganage solution (without acidification) with the correct descriptions of observation - change from purple to brown (ppt)).

topics: Topic 5: Fossil fuels and Carbon Compounds
questions.question: Briefly describe how polypropene can be produced from naphtha.

structuralAnswer.fullAnswer:
Cracking of naphtha gives a mixture of hydrocarbons which include propene.
Fractional distillation of the gaseous products can separate propene from other hydrocarbons.
Polymerisation of propene at elevated temperatures / > 45°C / high pressure / > 5 atm / in the presence of a suitable catalyst / Ziegler-Natta catalyst gives polypropene.

Communication mark
